# Pixel Invoice Builder

A polished, offline single-page invoice builder built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Features

- Add line items with description, quantity, and unit price.
- Each line shows its total (quantity × unit price) to two decimals.
- Subtotal, tax rate (percent), tax amount, and grand total update live.
- All monetary values are displayed to two decimals.
- Keyboard-accessible labeled controls with visible focus, hover, and pressed states.
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide upward.
- Cohesive 5-color palette on a themed background.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure.
- `styles.css` — styling and responsive layout.
- `script.js` — calculation logic and DOM interactions.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network connection is required.

1. Click **+ Add Line Item** to add a row.
2. Enter a description, quantity, and unit price.
3. Adjust the **Tax Rate (%)** input to see tax and grand total update.
4. Click the **×** button to remove a line item.

## Accessibility

- All inputs have associated labels or `aria-label` attributes.
- Buttons and inputs are keyboard-operable with visible focus rings.
- Logical tab order through items and totals.

## Constraints

- No imports, packages, network requests, external assets, iframes, or server code.
- No inline HTML event handlers.
- Uses relative paths and `.html`/`.css`/`.js`/`.md` extensions only.
- Includes `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` for hidden element support.

## Acceptance Checklist

- [x] Add line items with description, quantity, unit price.
- [x] Per-line totals displayed to two decimals.
- [x] Subtotal, tax, grand total computed to two decimals.
- [x] Tax rate input in percent.
- [x] Keyboard-accessible labeled controls.
- [x] Visible hover, focus, pressed states.
- [x] Layout works from 360px wide.
- [x] Cohesive palette and finished card design.
- [x] No disallowed features used.
